about: Who can select each table a restricted row of kb/cdc_data_dictionary.json lives in, measured live. kb/_build_cdc_sharing.py fails a restricted row whose table is missing here or open to anyone. Re-measure with the query below (read only) whenever a grant, an RLS policy or a gate function changes.
measured_by: SkyPlover (S660), Supabase project Work Plan, read only
query: select c.relname, c.relrowsecurity, has_table_privilege('anon', c.oid, 'select'), has_table_privilege('authenticated', c.oid, 'select'), and each select policy (pg_policy polcmd r or *) with its roles (none = PUBLIC) and pg_get_expr(polqual, polrelid), for every table a restricted row names

gates.is_funding_reviewer(): a signed-in reviewer on allowed_reviewers, or an unexpired, unrevoked funding_access grantee
gates.team_pass_ok(): anyone whose request carries the team phrase (the x-team-pass header)
